name: What are the most impactful upgrades for a small kitchen?

mainEntity.name: What are the most impactful upgrades for a small kitchen?

acceptedAnswer.text: For a small kitchen, the most impactful upgrades often focus on maximizing storage, improving lighting, and choosing space-saving solutions. Consider replacing bulky cabinets with custom, space-efficient options or adding pull-out pantry shelves. Brighten the space with under-cabinet lighting and strategic overhead fixtures. Compact, energy-efficient appliances, durable countertops, and a refreshed backsplash can also dramatically enhance both the functionality and aesthetics of a smaller kitchen without requiring a major layout change.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most impactful upgrades for a small kitchen include maximizing storage, improving lighting, choosing space-saving appliances, and updating countertops or backsplashes.
